newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SOCCER-BELGIUM COACH VAN MOER SACKED, LEEKENS NAMED.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BELGIUM COACH VAN MOER SACKED, LEEKENS NAMED.

text.p: Belgium soccer coach Wilfried Van Moer has been sacked after just nine months on the job and replaced by Georges Leekens, coach of surprise first division leaders Mouscron, a soccer union spokesman said on Tuesday.
"Confirmed," spokesman Guido Dewindt told Reuters when asked to comment on a report in Het Volk newspaper.

He said that Van Moer was sacked mainly because of Belgium's humiliating 3-0 defeat by the Netherlands in their World Cup qualifier last month, but also because of communication problems with players and media.
